title: Full site editing python tool
summary: I updated the tool I talked about on the previous post to let me edit the whole page.
content:
The script I talked about on the previous post now has **3** tabs. One for creating and editing *Blog* posts, another for *Projects,* and another for my *About* page descriptions and skills.

This is the Blog tab:

![blog tab](images/pasted_20260110_002009.png)

This is the Projects tab:

![projects tab](images/pasted_20260110_002036.png)

And this is the About tab:

![about tab](images/pasted_20260110_002057.png)

I also made it so that it lets me **Ctrl+V** images so I can easily add screenshots!
